title: From 2.2 million predicted crystals to 736 synthesized
caption: GNoME reported 2.2 million predicted crystals, 380,000 of them computationally stable; 736 had been independently synthesized by late 2023, about 0.2% of the stable set.

title: Six handoffs, six places for a prediction to fail
caption: Six sequential handoffs; each can introduce new error.
